summary: Verastem filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, reporting positive updated results from its Phase 1b/2a RAMP 205 trial of avutometinib plus defactinib in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy for first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer, and the dosing of the first patient in a Phase 2 trial of VS-7375. These are routine clinical trial updates, not a special situation. No change of control, capital return, restructuring, or any other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report of operational and regulatory milestones for a pharmaceutical company.
